subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should Google Vertex ADC setup accept project-only or metadata-server evidence and write project/location, marker profile, and default model state during onboarding?
rationale: The PR fixes a real setup gap, but it intentionally changes auth detection timing and setup-written defaults for an existing provider, which automation cannot define as the permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept ADC setup contract after docs fix
options.body: Land the proof-supplied path once the generated docs map is repaired, accepting permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, and setup-written defaults as the intended google-vertex behavior.

options.title: Narrow auth and default writes
options.body: Require the PR to keep stricter auth evidence or reduce setup-written config before merge if maintainers do not want onboarding to own those defaults.

options.title: Defer to Vertex cluster
options.body: Pause this PR behind #60736/#60860/#84123 if maintainers want the broader endpoint, location, and setup strategy settled together.

recommendation.title: Accept ADC setup contract after docs fix
recommendation.body: Land the proof-supplied path once the generated docs map is repaired, accepting permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, and setup-written defaults as the intended google-vertex behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Google transport/refactor work makes this the strongest available routing owner for the product-boundary decision.
